name: Stage 16:1: Åkers Styckebruk to Harsjöhult
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 16:1, Åkers Styckebruk to Harsjöhult.
utilities: Åkers Styckebruk is the practical transit and service end: bus 301 from Strängnäs and 306 from Läggesta stop near the start, and town services include grocery/restaurant options away from the immediate trail line.
Parking is available behind Folkets hus about 200 m from the official start, at/near the Lenellstorp road crossing, and at Harsjöhult/Gallsjömossen.

Harsjöhult is the endpoint junction for stages 16, 16:1, 17, and the Gallsjömossen loop. It has parking, a spring nearby, and official tenting context, but no verified toilet or shelter on 16:1 itself.

Stage 16:1 should stay sparse in the app: nearby shelters, toilets, springs, bathing spots, and firepits around Stage 16/Gallsjömossen/Sandviksbadet are mostly off-route and should not be counted as connector facilities.

Lenellstorp parking is real but coordinate-sensitive: official/Länsstyrelsen sources place a parking pocket with reserve sign where the trail crosses the road, while some OSM-derived pins drift away from the route corridor.
waterSources: The only official water point on the connector is the Harsjöhult spring near the endpoint; treat/filter it as natural water and carry enough from Åkers, especially in summer.
Åkers Styckebruk has town services and an OSM bottle-refill marker near the start, but this was not independently verified as a reliable public trail tap.
Mörtsjön, Göksjön, Flintsjön, and wetland water are natural/untested sources only and should not be presented as planned potable refills. Do not encode asking at summer houses for water as a source.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 11 km; Naturkartan lists 10.1 km, a 2026 Naturkartan GPX check measured about 10.13 km to the Harsjöhult/Gallsjömossen parking area, Äventyrligare lists about 9.9 km, OSM relation 19988674 is tagged 11 km but measures about 9.94 km, and AllTrails about 11.4-11.6 km with roughly 410 m ascent.

OSM relation 19988674 is geometrically usable but must be graph-oriented from the official Åkers start near node 2871861511 to the Harsjöhult junction node 2926356244. The first OSM member, way 1460424191, is stored opposite the official direction, and naive way-order traversal can create an apparent Åkers gap.

Access connector from Åkers Styckebruk to Harsjöhult: the first 2-3.5 km are mostly small roads, old railway bed, and slaggväg through old industrial/bruk landscape before the route feels properly forested, then Mörtsjön/Mörtsjö ringmur, old croft/fäbod and mining/charcoal traces, Lenellstorpkärret, Flintsjön/Gallsjömossen bog/boardwalk terrain, and the Harsjöhult junction.

Official pages for Stage 16:1, Stage 16, Stage 17, and the Gallsjömossen loop showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass; recent public reviews describe normal seasonal snow, mud, and wet-boardwalk variability rather than an active route closure.

Lenellstorpkärret is a sensitive rich fen/Natura 2000 reserve with orchids and wet ground. Länsstyrelsen says the reserve's short loop currently lacks boardwalk over the fen, while the official connector text says a marked western alternate can be preferable at high water or when boardwalks are icy.

Gallsjömossen reserve rules apply near Harsjöhult: do not damage living/dead trees or shrubs, collect restricted plants/fungi/lichens beyond allowed personal-use exceptions, damage invertebrate habitats, or arrange camps/competitions without permission. Gallsjömossen has a limited small-fire wood exception, but Lenellstorpkärret does not list the same exception; do not promise firewood, and fire bans/local signs override everything.

The official southbound Gallsjömossen alternative after the skvattrammosse and the separate OSM Gallsjömossen roundtrip relation 20102542 are route-builder context, not connector facilities. Attach them near node 8837652896/Harsjöhult and keep them optional rather than stitching them into the 16:1 mainline.

Mörtsjö ringmur is a worthwhile side-trip/viewpoint and heritage point with visible hillfort/ring-wall context and a nearby route-side picnic/view point; present it as optional heritage/rest context, not a core service facility.
Bus 306 can include demand-responsive/taxi-coded departures with limited capacity and advance phone booking; check Sörmlandstrafiken carefully for late, weekend, and Sunday plans.

General dog-control and fishing rules still matter: from 1 March to 20 August dogs must not run loose where wildlife can be disturbed, and fishing in the route lakes is not covered by allemansrätten unless a permit/right-holder rule is verified.

facilities.name: Åkers Styckebruk trail start
facilities.description: Official connector start and bus access area. Sörmlandsleden names bus 301 from Strängnäs and 306 from Läggesta; check current departures. Naturkartan's no-stop lookup is not reliable for this start.

facilities.name: Åkers Styckebruk bus stop
facilities.description: Closest mapped bus stop for the start; useful for train-to-Läggesta plus bus 306, or bus 301 from Strängnäs. Nearby Folkets hus stop is around 59.253536,17.097639.

facilities.name: Åkers Folkets hus parking
facilities.description: Parking behind Folkets hus/Mötesplats Åker, about 200 m from the official start. Check local signs before leaving a car.

facilities.name: Åkers Styckebruk bottle refill
facilities.description: OSM-mapped bottle refill near the start, tagged 24/7; useful if working but not independently verified as an official public trail tap.

facilities.name: ICA Åkers Styckebruk
facilities.description: Town grocery/resupply option on Solbergavägen. ICA lists broad daily opening hours and services, but verify current hours before relying on it.

facilities.name: Karas Restaurang & Pizzeria
facilities.description: Restaurant/pizzeria in Åkers Styckebruk, useful before/after the connector but off the immediate trail line; verify opening hours.

facilities.name: Åkers bruksmuseum and old industrial area
facilities.description: Old ironworks/industrial landscape near the early route. Museum in the old grain store and red-vimpel heritage-sign access are seasonal/opening-hour dependent, not dependable daily services.

facilities.name: Mörtsjön scenic lake context
facilities.description: Scenic lake/rest context after the early road/bruk section. Natural lake water only; a 2025 hiker review mentioned barbecue/bathing-rock context near Mörtsjön, but no reliable official bathing/fireplace facility was verified for the connector.

facilities.name: Mörtsjö ringmur rest/view point
facilities.description: Route-side rest/view context below Mörtsjö ringmur. Sörmlandsleden describes the ring-wall hill as a suitable rest place with wide views; treat any picnic/fire details as field-check dependent.

facilities.name: Mörtsjö ringmur side trip
facilities.description: Ancient hillfort/viewpoint side trip near Mörtsjön with an approximately 85 x 65 m enclosure and visible wall remains. It sits just off the connector with signed/path access; show as optional spur/context rather than a core connector facility.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet off-route bathing/fire context
facilities.description: Sandviksbadet/Göksjön is a real bathing place with facilities, but it is about 1.5 km off official 16:1 geometry. Show only as optional detour context, not as an on-route facility.

facilities.name: Hagalund / Åkerby fäboda remains
facilities.description: Approximate old fäbod/croft, former cultivated land, and large-oak landscape context mentioned by official text and hiker reports; route-snap if more exact data appears.

facilities.name: Göksjötorp mining traces
facilities.description: Göksjötorp and nearby old mine-hole/spoil-heap context; official text places mining traces on hills west of the torp. Treat as a safety/heritage area and do not enter pits or disturb remains.

facilities.name: Charcoal and mining traces near Gallsjömossen
facilities.description: Approximate route-near charcoal/mining context corroborated by OSM and reserve/official descriptions. Treat as heritage/safety context and avoid disturbing remains.

facilities.name: Flintsjön natural-water context
facilities.description: Scenic lake near the connector after the high point north of Flintsjön. Natural lake water only; do not present as potable refill.

facilities.name: Lenellstorp / Lenellstorpkärret parking pocket
facilities.description: Official/Länsstyrelsen sources say a parking pocket with reserve sign exists where Sörmlandsleden crosses the road by Lenellstorp/Lenellstorpkärret. Treat as limited roadside/access parking, not a serviced trailhead; OSM-derived pins disagree, so verify signs/safe stopping on arrival.

facilities.name: Lenellstorpkärret wetland warning
facilities.description: Sensitive rich fen/Natura 2000 reserve with orchids and wet ground. Länsstyrelsen says the reserve's short loop currently lacks boardwalk over the fen; use the marked alternate when high water or icy/wet passage makes the main line unsuitable. No firewood exception is listed for this reserve.

facilities.name: Gallsjömossen reserve warning
facilities.description: Bog, old-pine forest, boardwalked wet parts, rocky/knobbly ground, old mining landscape, and reserve rules near Harsjöhult. Do not damage vegetation/deadwood or sensitive habitats; berry/edible mushroom/flower picking for own use is allowed where signs permit.

facilities.name: Gallsjömossen southern alternative
facilities.description: Route-builder context only: official text describes a southbound alternative after the skvattrammosse through mining ground and periodically wet mires/boardwalks, reconnecting toward stage 16 about 500 m from Harsjöhult.

facilities.name: Gallsjömossen loop attachment
facilities.description: Topology marker for optional Gallsjömossen roundtrip relation 20102542. It attaches near the Harsjöhult end via node 8837652896; do not treat the loop as part of the 16:1 mainline by default.

facilities.name: Lavansjö gruvor / Lavansjön mine area
facilities.description: Mapped mine/heritage area near the Gallsjömossen approach and alternative line; about 200 m from the connector geometry and best shown as nearby heritage context.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult information map
facilities.description: Information/map context at the Harsjöhult access point.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult / Gallsjömossen parking
facilities.description: Parking for Gallsjömossen, stage 16, 16:1, and 17; Länsstyrelsen describes the reserve as about 500 m from the parking.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult spring
facilities.description: Official endpoint spring near Harsjöhult, corroborated by OSM. Treat/filter as natural water, and do not assume flow/quality in drought or freezing conditions.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult tent context
facilities.description: Official text says Harsjöhult is suitable for tenting; this is informal, not a formal campsite with toilet/shelter. Keep groups small, avoid blocking trail/parking/private land, and follow reserve signs and fire bans.

facilities.name: Harsjöhult stage junction
facilities.description: Connector endpoint and route-builder junction for stages 16, 16:1, 17, and the Gallsjömossen loop. 16:1 joins the main Sörmlandsleden about 40 m before the stage 16/17 split.
